categories.name: Chest
categories.description: Chest training targets the pectorals. It is essential for upper body pushing strength.
categories.howTo: Keep shoulder blades retracted and control the weight on the descent.
categories.benefit: Improved pushing power and better posture.

categories.name: Back
categories.description: Back training involves the lats and rhomboids. It protects your spine.
categories.howTo: Pull with your elbows and squeeze your shoulder blades at the peak.
categories.benefit: Balanced posture and a stronger core.

categories.name: Legs
categories.description: Leg day covers quads and glutes. These are the largest muscles in the body.
categories.howTo: Keep feet flat and core tight. Ensure knees stay in line with toes.
categories.benefit: Massive functional strength and high calorie burn.

categories.name: Cardio
categories.description: Cardio improves heart health and endurance.
categories.howTo: Maintain a steady pace that raises your heart rate.
